battle.name: 努比亞征服埃及
battle.theater: 尼羅河谷（納帕塔至孟斐斯）
battle.brief: 公元前七三二年前後，庫施王皮伊應赫拉利奧波利斯求援，率軍自納帕塔沿尼羅河北上，直抵孟斐斯，逼得薩斯的泰夫納赫特寫信認輸，三角洲諸王亦出城稱臣，埃及第二十五王朝由此開國。卡面斯巴達長矛並未隨軍北上，這支部隊用的是複合弓、短矛與手斧；那件兵器當時在愛琴海方陣裡決定過誰站得住。

kit.name: 斯巴達長矛
kit.history: 兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套。方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住。

countries: 努比亞征服埃及是前八世紀下半葉庫施王國自南方沿尼羅河谷北上、終結埃及分立諸王混戰的一場戰爭。庫施一方是國王皮伊與他的王軍，統治核心在納帕塔，膜拜中心在傑貝爾巴爾卡爾的阿蒙大神廟；皮伊以「阿蒙之子」自居，出徵前令全軍行潔淨禮，作聖戰看待，軍隊裡有步卒弓手、近戰重裝兵與王族衛隊，並配有一支沿河航行的船隊。埃及一方則是「瑪」階層的大小首領：薩斯的泰夫納赫特打著統一三角洲的旗號，聯合利安托波利斯的伊普特二世、坦尼斯的奧索爾孔四世等北方諸王，又把原先與庫施結盟的赫爾莫波利斯王尼姆洛特拉到自己一邊，聯軍把赫拉利奧波利斯圍成孤城。赫拉利奧波利斯王佩夫特阿維亞瓦斯特與城中的數位「瑪」首領見勢不妙，遣使越過第一瀑布向納帕塔求援，於是庫施的大軍第一次成建制地踏進埃及腹地。交戰雙方共用同一條尼羅河、同一套神祇傳統與同一批部族血緣，這場戰爭因此更像王朝聯盟與宗室內政的混合體，而不像兩國之間的邊界衝突；勝者也不自稱征服者，而是以法老的身分接管埃及的行政與祭祀秩序。
countriesEn: The Nubian conquest of Egypt was the war in which the kingdom of Kush marched up the Nile valley from the south in the second half of the eighth century BC and put an end to the divided rule of the local Egyptian kings. On the Kushite side stood King Piye and his royal army, governed from Napata in Nubia and centred devotionally on the great temple of Amun at Jebel Barkal; Piye styled himself a son of Amun, had his whole force ritually purified before the campaign and treated the expedition as a holy war, and his host combined foot archers, close-combat spearmen and the royal guard with a flotilla that moved along the river. On the Egyptian side stood the network of Ma commanders: Tefnakht of Sais, who had raised a banner of unification in the Delta, joined with Iuput II of Leontopolis, Osorkon IV of Tanis and the other northern princes, and drew Nimlot of Hermopolis, Piye's nominal ally, over to his side, so that the coalition closed in on the besieged city of Herakleopolis. Peftjauawybast, king of Herakleopolis, and several Ma leaders in the city, seeing their position turn bad, sent an embassy across the first cataract to Napata, and it was that embassy which brought a Kushite army into the heart of Egypt for the first time. Both sides shared one river, one body of god-lore and a good deal of common blood, so the war was less a clash between two states than a mixture of dynastic alliance and civil war; the victor never called himself a conqueror but took up the role of pharaoh over Egypt's administration and its temples.
people: 皮伊是這場戰爭的決定者。庫施王子，父為卡什塔、母為佩巴特瑪，登基後用過烏西馬里與斯涅弗拉兩個王號，在位約前七四四至前七一四年，是埃及第二十五王朝的奠基者。北方盟友的崩解才是導火線：原與他同盟的赫爾莫波利斯王尼姆洛特被薩斯的泰夫納赫特拉走，赫拉利奧波利斯王佩夫特阿維亞瓦斯特與城內數位「瑪」首領派使者向庫施求救，皮伊在王位第二十年前後集結大軍北上。他身後的《勝利頌》石碑，即傑貝爾巴爾卡爾勝利碑，記載了這場戰役的經過；碑文帶詩節與對話，篇幅遠超一般戰功銘刻，一般認為出自底比斯祭司集團之手，作者究竟是皮伊本人還是後來的沙巴卡，學界至今仍有爭議；一八六二年法國考古學家馬里埃特在傑貝爾巴爾卡爾發現了這段碑文。泰夫納赫特是對手方最關鍵的人物：他從薩斯起兵，先取赫爾莫波利斯，再把三角洲諸王拉成聯盟，最後退入三角洲的一座島上，寫信向皮伊認輸。伊普特二世、奧索爾孔四世這些北方之王後來各自率城出降，北方諸王的政治表態決定了戰局如何收束。皮伊的兄弟沙巴塔卡後來坐鎮埃及，他的兒子塔哈爾卡更把庫施的勢力推到頂峰。
peopleEn: Piye was the man who decided this war. A Kushite prince, son of King Kashta and Queen Pebatjma, he took the throne names Usimare and Sneferre, reigned from roughly 744 to 714 BC and became the founder of Egypt's Twenty-fifth Dynasty. It was the collapse of his northern alliances that lit the fuse: Nimlot of Hermopolis, once bound to him, was won over by Tefnakht of Sais, and the king of Herakleopolis, Peftjauawybast, together with several Ma leaders in the city, sent envoys to Kush for help, so that Piye mustered a large army in or about the twentieth year of his reign. His doings were set down on the Victory Stela of Jebel Barkal, the monument that carries the text known as the Great Hymn; the inscription is cast in verse and dialogue and runs far beyond the length of an ordinary victory record, and it is generally ascribed to the Theban priestly establishment, while the question whether its author was Piye himself or the later Shabaka is still argued. The stela was discovered at Jebel Barkal by the French Egyptologist Auguste Mariette in 1862. Tefnakht was the decisive figure on the Egyptian side: he rose from Sais, absorbed Hermopolis, drew the Delta princes into his league, and finally withdrew to an island in the Delta, where he conceded defeat in a letter to Piye. The northern kings, Iuput II and Osorkon IV among them, later came out of their cities and submitted, and it was the way the princes handled that submission which closed the campaign. Piye's brother Shabataka afterwards held Egypt, and Piye's son Taharqa carried Kushite power to its height.
kits: 卡面的斯巴達長矛屬於愛琴海世界的前線兵器：前八世紀的希臘重裝步兵把它立在地上當盾牌的支架，列陣時從盾與盾的縫隙間刺出；槍尾的銅套讓長矛落地時不致折斷，斷下的矛尖還能拆下來當短兵使用。這整套裝備從未出現在尼羅河上，這一點必須說清楚：皮伊的隊伍用的是另一套傳統。庫施的近戰主力是短矛、手斧與柳葉形匕首，護身用生牛皮或木條拼合的圓盾；投射武器才是庫施人的看家本領，一種上段短、下段長、反曲明顯的複合弓，在新王國時期的埃及浮雕與墓室壁畫中就已畫滿了從南方來的弓手，說明這支部族用弓的傳統遠早於皮伊。埃及方面此時已不再用月牙形的鉎刀，標準的近戰武器是斧、矛與柳盾，戰車仍是貴族與將領的座車，卻已不再是野戰主力。皮伊的遠征還靠尼羅河上的船隊：碑文記載船隻溯流而上，船上載著弓手，這支水陸兩用的隊伍既餵得飽遠征軍，也把三角洲諸城封在下游。整套體系裡沒有斯巴達長矛的位置，但有功能上的等價物：庫施人的長矛同樣是列陣時向前推出的刺擊兵器，只是形制、銅套與持握法屬於另一個世界。
kitsEn: The card's dory belongs to the front line of the Aegean world: in the eighth century BC the Greek hoplite planted it in the ground as a rest for his shield and thrust it forward through the gaps between shields; the bronze socket on its butt kept the shaft from breaking when it was driven into the earth, and a broken-off head could be detached and used as a short weapon. None of that equipment ever reached the Nile, and the point must be stated plainly: Piye's troops carried a different tradition. The close-combat core of the Kushite army was short spears, hand axes and leaf-shaped daggers, protected by round shields of rawhide or wood. The missile weapon was the Kushite speciality, a recurved composite bow, short above and long below, a shape already painted with Nubian archers in the reliefs and tomb-paintings of the New Kingdom, which shows that this people's tradition of the bow long predated Piye. Egypt in this period had given up the crescent khopesh, and the standard close-combat weapons were axe, spear and willow shield; the chariot remained the vehicle of the nobility and the commanders and no longer a field arm. Piye's expedition also rested on the boats of the Nile: the stela records ships going upstream with archers aboard, and this waterborne half of the army both fed the marching column and sealed the Delta cities from below. There is no place for a Spartan dory in that order of battle, but there is a functional equivalent: the Kushite spear, like the dory, was a thrusting weapon used to drive an ordered line forward, only its form, socket and grip belong to a different world.
tactics: 皮伊的戰法與地中海世界的方陣全然不同，核心是河流行軍與心態戰。軍隊自納帕塔出發，沿尼羅河谷節節北進，先以小股前鋒與弓手試探敵軍，再由船隊載著弓手溯流直逼孟斐斯；船隊的出現讓對手相信上游已無防備，守軍的士氣先於第一擊崩潰。赫爾莫波利斯一役拖了五個月，圍城本身就是戰術：庫施軍沒有強攻，而是切斷陸路、封鎖河運，把守軍壓在缺糧的困境裡。皮伊兵臨赫拉利奧波利斯城下之時，碑文記下一場暴風，埃及方面視之為神罰，軍心由此鬆動；泰夫納赫特退往三角洲島上，寫信乞和，北方諸王隨後一個個帶著金子與印璽出城，在河灘上稱臣。整場戰爭幾乎沒有一次大規模的正面撞擊。皮伊把戰役定位為聖戰，開戰前令全軍行潔淨禮、祭獻阿蒙，遇城不屠、不拆神廟、不改祭祀人員的職位，反過來給了北方諸王繼續坐在王位上的機會；這是典型的以政治收編代替殘滅的打法。補給線隨軍隊沿河延伸，靠船運糧食、靠沿岸寺廟的供應維持遠征，戰利品與俘虜則沿河送回納帕塔。
tacticsEn: Piye's way of fighting had nothing in common with the phalanx of the Mediterranean; its core was marching by river and a war fought on morale. The army set out from Napata and advanced north up the valley in stages, testing the enemy first with outposts and archers, then bringing up a flotilla of boats carrying archers to sail upstream to Memphis. The appearance of that flotilla persuaded the defenders that the upper river was undefended, and their nerve broke before the first blow was struck. The siege of Hermopolis lasted five months, and the siege was itself a tactic: the Kushite army did not storm the walls but cut the land routes and closed the river traffic, pinning the garrison in a shortage of food. While Piye was before Herakleopolis the stela records a great storm, which the Egyptians read as divine punishment, and the defenders' morale gave out; Tefnakht withdrew to his island in the Delta and sent a letter asking for terms, and one after another the northern kings came out of their cities with gold and seals and knelt on the river bank. Almost no large clash of arms took place. Piye framed the campaign as a holy war: the army was purified before it marched, he made offerings to Amun, and in the cities he took he neither massacred, nor pulled down the temples, nor dismissed the priests from their offices, which gave the northern kings the chance to keep their thrones. It was conquest by political absorption in place of destruction. The supply line followed the army along the river, with grain moved by boat and provisions drawn from the temples of the country, while booty and prisoners were carried back downriver to Napata.
data: 這場戰爭的數字主要來自《勝利頌》石碑的碑文與後世王表，可以確定的有以下幾項。皮伊在王位第二十一年自納帕塔出兵，換算約當公元前七三〇年代中期，確切年份仍有爭議；他的統治期約前七四四至前七一四年，在位約三十年。從納帕塔到孟斐斯，沿尼羅河順流而下約一千五百至一千八百公里，軍隊與糧船順水下行，逆水則靠岸邊人力拖曳，這是遠征時間被拉長的主因。赫爾莫波利斯被圍五個月，這是碑文給出的唯一明確作戰時長。三角洲聯軍諸王的數目，後世常記為十位上下，碑文則以「北方諸侯」統稱之。皮伊的軍隊人數碑文未載；按當時尼羅河谷諸國的常規估算，交戰雙方投入的兵力都在數萬之譜，庫施一方以弓手為步卒主力，另有前鋒重裝兵、王族衛隊、船隊與數輛王室戰車。戰果方面，泰夫納赫特認輸後仍保留薩斯的地位，北方諸王全部保留王號，庫施對埃及的統治自皮伊算起延續約七十五年，直到前六五六年普薩姆提克一世逐出末代庫施王才告終。月份方面，碑文只留下王年與泛舟季的提示，換算現代月序只能取約數，本卡記為七月。
dataEn: The figures for this war come chiefly from the text of the Victory Stela and from later king lists, and several of them can be stated with confidence. Piye marched out of Napata in the twenty-first year of his reign, which converts to the middle of the 730s BC, though the exact year is still argued; his reign ran from about 744 to 714 BC, some thirty years. From Napata to Memphis the river runs roughly fifteen hundred to eighteen hundred kilometres, and the army and its grain boats drifted down with the current, while upstream movement depended on men hauling along the bank; that is the main reason the expedition took so long. The siege of Hermopolis lasted five months, the only clear duration of operations the stela gives. The number of princes in the Delta coalition is usually given as about ten, though the stela refers to them collectively as the lords of the north. The stela records no headcount; on the scale customary for the states of the Nile valley, both sides fielded forces in the tens of thousands, the Kushite infantry being mostly archers, with vanguard spearmen, the royal guard, a flotilla and a few royal chariots. On the result, Tefnakht was allowed to keep his position at Sais, all the northern kings kept their titles, and Kushite rule over Egypt counted about seventy-five years from Piye until Psamtik I drove out the last Kushite king in 656 BC. As for the month, the stela preserves only a regnal year and a hint of the inundation season, so any conversion into a modern calendar month is an approximation; this card records July.
cause: 戰爭的直接起因是埃及北部的分裂與求援。前八世紀上半葉，利比亞系的「瑪」家族已在尼羅河三角洲立國，第二十二、二十三王朝交替之際秩序崩解；泰夫納赫特以薩斯為基地逐步吞併赫爾莫波利斯與三角洲諸城，把自己的勢力圈推成一個聯盟，把剩下兩座城——赫拉利奧波利斯與赫爾莫波利斯——圍在饑餓裡。這兩城既無力自保，又不願併入泰夫納赫特的聯盟，唯一的出路是向南方那個同樣信奉阿蒙、並且長期被上埃及視做法老來源地的庫施求援。請援的消息抵達納帕塔時，皮伊正忙於安排自己的王位繼承；但對他而言，出兵並非單純的救援，而是一次把勢力推過第一瀑布的機會：庫施王早已在傑貝爾巴爾卡爾的峭壁上留下自己是埃及合法法老的自我認定，一旦踏上埃及土地，就可以同時以「阿蒙的仆人」和「埃及之王」兩重身分行事。皮伊後來在碑文裡自稱這是一場前代法老未曾打過的聖戰，可見他並不否認，這是一場由神義支撐的擴張。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the war was the fragmentation of northern Egypt and a desperate appeal for help. In the first half of the eighth century BC the Libyan Ma families had established themselves in the Delta, and the transition from the Twenty-second to the Twenty-third Dynasty had broken the old order. Working from Sais, Tefnakht absorbed Hermopolis and one Delta city after another, turned his territory into a league, and left two cities, Herakleopolis and Hermopolis, to be starved. Those two had neither the strength to hold out nor the will to join Tefnakht's league, and their only road was an appeal to Kush in the south, to a kingdom that worshipped the same god Amun and had long been treated in Upper Egypt as the fountainhead of the pharaohs. When the plea reached Napata, Piye was occupied with the internal arrangements of his own succession; for him, however, the expedition was not simply relief. It was the chance to push power up past the first cataract: the Kushite king had long inscribed at Jebel Barkal his own claim to be a lawful pharaoh of Egypt, and once he stood on Egyptian soil he could act both as the servant of Amun and as king of Egypt. In the stela Piye calls the campaign a holy war such as no ancestor had waged, which shows that he did not pretend this was anything other than an expansion backed by divine sanction.
impact: 皮伊的勝利改變了埃及，也改變了這條河的上下游。埃及第二十五王朝成立，庫施王以法老身分同時統治納帕塔與孟斐斯，直到前六六三年亞述軍入埃及、前六五六年普薩姆提克一世逐出末代國王為止，庫施人做埃及法老約七十五年；其後他們退回南方，把首都遷往麥羅伊，發展成麥羅伊蒂王國，兩地的族群與政治連結又延續了數百年。後來的埃及人把皮伊寫進法老名錄，也把這場征服視為合法而非外來：皮伊本人在碑文裡強調自己是阿蒙之子、埃及法老的正統繼承者，甚至責備底比斯的阿蒙祭司干政與貪婪，認為正是他們讓三角洲諸王爭鬥、讓北方陷入饑荒。這段自責式的檢討在古埃及的宣傳文獻裡極為罕見，也說明這場征服在埃及的自我敘事中很快被收編為王朝合法性的開端。對外，埃及重新打通通往紅海與努比亞的商路，麥羅伊與埃及之間雙向的物資交換、尼羅河上游的黃金與象牙貿易恢復興旺；對內，第二十五王朝的君主在卡瓦與底比斯大興土木，留下的柱像與方尖碑至今仍是學者重建那個時代的依據。
impactEn: Piye's victory changed Egypt and changed the two ends of the river. The Twenty-fifth Dynasty of Egypt was founded, and Kushite kings ruled as pharaohs over both Napata and Memphis until the Assyrians entered Egypt in 663 BC and Psamtik I expelled the last of them in 656 BC, a span of about seventy-five years of Kushite pharaohs. Afterwards the dynasty withdrew south, moved its capital to Meroe and grew into the Meroitic kingdom, so that the political and ethnic link between the two countries ran on for several more centuries. Later Egyptians entered Piye in their king lists and treated the conquest as legitimate rather than foreign: in the stela Piye himself insisted that he was a son of Amun and the legitimate successor of the pharaohs, and even blamed the Theban priests of Amun for their interference and their greed, holding that it was they who had set the Delta princes against one another and brought famine on the north. This self-accusing passage is extremely rare in Egyptian propaganda literature, and it shows how quickly the conquest was folded into Egypt's own story of legitimate rule. Abroad, Egypt reopened its trade routes to the Red Sea and Nubia, and the exchange of goods between Meroe and Egypt, the trade in gold and ivory from the upper Nile, grew busy again. At home, the kings of the Twenty-fifth Dynasty built on a great scale at Kawa and Thebes, and the columns and obelisks they left behind remain the chief evidence on which that age is reconstructed.
result: 戰役以皮伊的完全勝利告終。赫拉利奧波利斯解圍，赫爾莫波利斯在五個月圍城後陷落，孟斐斯與底比斯先後開城；泰夫納赫特退到三角洲的島上，最後以書信向皮伊認輸，承認自己是他的僕人，庫施軍隊隨後開入孟斐斯，坐上王位。皮伊沒有像許多征服者那樣拆毀神廟或撤換祭祀人員，他在孟斐斯的普塔神廟接受潔淨儀式，把北方諸王留在原位充當附庸，重新確認底比斯阿蒙神祭司的傳統地位，然後帶著繳獲的金銀、北方諸王的貢禮與神廟的祝福返回納帕塔，在故土慶祝尼羅河的良好泛舟與收成，之後不久便去世。整場征服因此沒有留下被焚的城市，改變的是埃及的王朝構成：第二十五王朝自此開國，庫施的血統進入埃及王室的譜系，埃及的歷史從「分王林立的晚期王朝」轉入「外來王朝治下的短暫中興」，並在不到半個世紀之後，遇上亞述這個更硬的新主人。
resultEn: The war ended in Piye's complete victory. Herakleopolis was relieved, Hermopolis fell after five months of siege, and Memphis and Thebes opened their gates in turn. Tefnakht withdrew to his island in the Delta and finally conceded defeat in a letter to Piye, calling himself his servant, and the Kushite army then entered Memphis and took the throne. Piye did not, as conquerors often do, destroy the temples or dismiss the priests. He was purified in the temple of Ptah at Memphis, left the northern kings in place as vassals, confirmed the ancient position of the Theban priesthood of Amun, and then returned to Napata with the gold and silver taken, the tribute of the northern kings and the blessings of the temples, where he celebrated the good inundation and the harvest of his own country; he died not long afterwards. The conquest therefore left no cities burnt. What it changed was the composition of the Egyptian dynasty: the Twenty-fifth Dynasty was founded, Kushite blood entered the pharaonic genealogy, and Egyptian history moved from the late period of rival local dynasties into a brief revival under a foreign dynasty, which within less than half a century met Assyria, a tougher new master.
